item.text: {"scenario_id":"completion-proof-claim","arm":"baseline","decision":"completion_evidence_blocked","recommended_owner":"skill-refiner","would_edit_now":false,"asks_for_user_confirmation":false,"checks_existing_capability":false,"final_operation_timing":"not_decided","treats_old_tests_as_evidence_not_goal":false,"considers_consumers":false,"requires_result_json_validation":true,"gives_lightweight_path":false,"uses_with_without_eval":false,"next_steps":["不能收口；“已经完成了”不是完成证据。","退回 skill-refiner 补齐完成门禁：生成或提供 skill-refiner-result.json，并做 fresh validation。","用新验证结果逐条对照成功标准；若验证失败，先定位根因再决定是否继续 refinement。","只有 completion artifact 和 fresh validation 都存在且通过后，才允许进入收口判断。"],"risk_notes":["缺少 skill-refiner-result.json 会导致结果不可审计、不可复验。","缺少 fresh validation 意味着优化后行为没有当前证据，不能用口头声明替代。","现在收口会把未证实完成误标为完成，生命周期状态不可信。"],"reason_summary":"场景明确是完成声明但缺少必需完成产物和 fresh validation，因此被完成证据门禁阻断；下一步不是继续收口，而是由 skill-refiner 补齐结果 JSON 与新验证证据后再判断。"}
